name: idle-compact
description: Compacts an idle interactive session shortly before its prompt cache expires, so coming back later doesn't re-read the whole context uncached.

idleMinutes.title: Idle minutes
idleMinutes.description: Minutes idle before compacting. 0 means automatic: 50 on a 1-hour prompt cache, off on a 5-minute one.

minTokens.title: Minimum context tokens
minTokens.description: Leave smaller contexts alone: re-reading them cold is cheap.
